resources.string: Let the screen use the full backlight power

The stock firmware runs the backlight at no more than about two-thirds of its full power. Brightness boost removes those limits, so at full brightness the screen is about 50% brighter, and every other brightness level is brighter too.\n\nWhile it\'s on, MediaTek\'s display tuning (AAL) is turned off. The screen uses more power and gets warmer at high brightness. If the phone gets hot, it dims the screen automatically.
Let the GPU run at up to 1100 MHz

This phone\'s GPU is limited to 1003 MHz. GPU boost raises the limit to 1100 MHz, the top speed MediaTek rates for this chip, at the voltages the chip is calibrated for. Graphics-heavy games and emulators run up to about 10% faster.\n\nThe phone uses more power and gets warmer while the GPU is busy. If it gets hot, it slows the GPU down automatically.
